About this property

Godrej Aveline is a landmark ultra-luxury development spanning approximately 10 acres in a prime North Bengaluru location. This project is meticulously designed for elevated living, featuring around 800 ultra-luxury residences comprising spacious 3, 3.5 and 4.5 BHK homes with large floor plans. The development is strategically situated on the main road, ensuring unmatched connectivity and superior access. Residents will enjoy direct access to the Yelahanka Metro Station and seamless connectivity to the Kempegowda International Airport. It is also well-connected to the Yelahanka Railway Station and direct access to NH-75, placing major IT Parks, employment hubs, and the CBD within easy reach. The development is further enhanced by 40+ world-class amenities and is surrounded by top educational, healthcare, and retail facilities like the Mall of Asia, making it a strong proposition for both end-use and investment.
